schema.description: Delegate one focused, self-contained task to a child run and return its final result.
schema.name: agent

description.description: One-line summary of the delegated task.

prompt.description: The task or question for the child run.

tools.description: Optional capability subset for the child run.

schema.description: Run 2-8 independent child tasks concurrently. Each task may select a kind, capability subset, file contract, and prompt-cache mode.
schema.name: agent_parallel

cache_mode.description: Default prompt cache strategy for the batch.
Prompt cache strategy for this child.

forbidden_files.description: Files this child must not modify.

output_files.description: Files this child is expected to write.

prompt.description: Task or question for this child run.

success_criteria.description: How to judge this child task complete.

task_id.description: Stable identifier for this child task.

schema.description: Check Agent-Reach internet channels and active upstream backends. Use before platform-specific research or when an internet channel fails.
schema.name: agent_reach_doctor

channels.description: Optional channel names such as github, web, youtube, rss.

schema.description: Read a public URL through Agent-Reach channel routing and its active backend. For GitHub or another platform URL, Agent-Reach selects the platform and falls back to its Web/Jina Reader backend when needed.
schema.name: agent_reach_read

schema.description: Discover launch candidates and report a separate launchability probe.
schema.name: app_discover

schema.description: Launch a discovered application with argv and verify the PID identity afterward.
schema.name: app_launch

schema.description: Wait for durable child runs owned by the current parent and collect results.
schema.name: await_subagents

schema.description: Build a process-isolated reusable capability only after a current stamped capability_search proves no adequate executable match. Existing generic tools should be preferred for one-off actions.
schema.name: capability_build

objective.description: The unchanged parent objective that requires a reusable deterministic adapter.

original_args.description: Canonical arguments the generated adapter must support. This is frozen into builder lineage.

scope.description: Use run for one task, project for project-shaped reuse, and user only for explicitly cross-project reuse.

schema.description: Repair a managed capability from one host-signed failure receipt. The host derives the objective, immutable parent version, canonical failed arguments, and binding scope.
schema.name: capability_repair

failure_receipt_ref.description: The exact receipt returned by a failed capability tool call. Free-form error text is not accepted.

schema.description: Load one exact context reference prepared for this request.
schema.name: context_page_in

schema.description: Create a file on the user's Desktop with given name and content. Cross-platform.
schema.name: desktop_create_file

schema.description: Create a new Word .docx locally from a structured spec. Elements: heading{text,level,color}, paragraph{text OR runs:[{text,bold,italic,underline,color:'#RRGGBB',font_size}], bold,italic,color,align,font_size}, list{items,ordered,level}, table{rows,header,header_fill,header_color,style}, image{path,width_in,align}, page_break. Top-level spec keys: title, header (str), footer (str), page_number (bool, adds live page numbers). Saves to 桌宠/OutPut/Doc by default — tell the user the full returned path.
schema.name: doc_create

output_path.description: Absolute .docx path; omit to auto-create in temp.

schema.description: Apply targeted edits to an existing .docx in place, preserving styles. Ops: replace{find,replace,paragraph_index?}, set_paragraph_text{index,text}, insert_paragraph{text,after_index?,style?}, set_table_cell{table_index,row,col,text}. The file must first be chosen by the user via office_pick_file.
schema.name: doc_edit

ops.description: List of edit-op dicts (or a JSON string of one).

schema.description: Read an existing .docx into a structured outline (paragraphs with index/text/style, tables with dimensions). Call this BEFORE doc_edit to learn where to edit. The file must first be chosen by the user via office_pick_file.
schema.name: doc_read

schema.description: Download one http/https URL with a hard byte cap, optional SHA-256, and atomic publish.
schema.name: download_file

schema.description: Replace exact text in a file. old_string must be unique unless replace_all=true. If exact match fails and fuzzy=true (default), falls back to whitespace/anchor matching and otherwise returns did_you_mean suggestions; set fuzzy=false to require an exact match only.
schema.name: edit_file

schema.description: Generate a professional .xlsx spreadsheet locally from a structured spec. Supports multiple sheets, live formulas (any cell value starting with '='), charts (bar/line/pie, single or many per sheet), conditional formatting, header styling, frozen panes, column widths, number formats (currency/percent/thousands/date), merged cells, per-cell styling (fill/font color/border/align) and embedded images. Returns the file path (default 桌宠/OutPut/Excel) — tell the user the full path. Decide the data layout first, then call this.
schema.name: excel_create

output_path.description: Absolute .xlsx path. Omit to auto-save under 桌宠/OutPut/Excel. A non-temp directory must have been picked by the user.

spec.description: Dict (or JSON string of a dict) with a 'sheets' list. Each sheet supports: name, rows (list of row lists), header_row, column_widths, freeze_panes, conditional_format, chart, charts (list), number_formats (list of {range|col, format} e.g. {col:'B',format:'#,##0.00'} or {col:'C',format:'0.0%'}), merge_cells (list of 'A1:C1'), cell_styles (list of {range, bold, italic, font_color:'#RRGGBB', fill:'#RRGGBB', align, font_size, border, wrap}), images (list of {path, anchor, width, height}). A cell value like '=SUM(B2:B5)' becomes a live formula.

schema.description: Pause the current action when progress requires an external user step that Simple Harness cannot perform, such as accepting a Windows UAC prompt, signing in, or supplying content in a third-party application. The host resumes this exact call and Attempt after the user reports the step was handled. Treat that signal only as permission to continue: re-probe the real external state before claiming success. The wait is not a tool failure and does not consume a retry.
schema.name: external_action_wait

evidence_refs.description: Optional references proving why the external step is required.

required_action.description: A concrete, safe instruction describing the one external action the user must finish.

schema.description: Retrieve the full body (or a slice) of a previously-truncated tool_result by its ref_id. The ref_id appears in the truncation marker like '[truncated 8421 chars, ref_id=abc123 …]'. Use this when the head/tail snippet wasn't enough and you need to see more of the original output. Slices are capped at 8000 chars per call — pass start/end to page through longer bodies.
schema.name: fetch_tool_result

end.description: Exclusive end offset (default start + 8000). Slice will be clamped to the body length.

ref_id.description: The ref_id from a truncation marker.

schema.description: List workspace files matching a glob pattern. Uses pathlib glob semantics (e.g. '**/*.md' for recursive markdown), while recursive workspace scans skip heavyweight generated directories by default. Returns workspace-relative paths.
schema.name: file_glob

schema.description: Search a workspace file line-by-line for a regex pattern. Returns matching line numbers + text. Useful for quick lookups before reading larger files.
schema.name: file_grep

schema.description: Tidy a folder the user has picked. mode='by_type' groups files into category subfolders, 'by_date' into YYYY-MM folders, 'dedup' lists byte-identical duplicates. ALWAYS call with dry_run=true first, show the user the plan, and only call again with dry_run=false after the user confirms. The folder must first be chosen via office_pick_file (kind='dir').
schema.name: file_organize

dry_run.description: True = return plan only (default). False = actually move files.

schema.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the Simple Harness workspace. Supports line offset + limit for large files. Returns content + lines_read.
schema.name: file_read

schema.description: Write UTF-8 text to a workspace file. 'overwrite' replaces the file; 'append' adds to the end. Parent directories are created automatically.
schema.name: file_write

schema.description: AI 文生图/原创生成图片工具。用户要生成、画、做海报、插画、图标、头像或保存一张新图片时必须用本工具；本工具会真实调用图像生成接口并把图片保存到本地 workspace 后返回路径。不要用 web_fetch、网页搜索或抓取网页去找图来替代图片生成。
schema.name: generate_image

prompt.description: 图片内容的文字描述（中英文均可，越具体越好）。

schema.description: Find files by glob pattern under the project root. Returns paths sorted by mtime (newest first).
schema.name: glob

schema.description: Lookup the latest spot gold price. Use this FIRST when the user asks 最新金价/今日黄金价格/现货黄金/XAU/USD/黄金多少钱一克. Returns USD/oz, USD/CNY, and estimated CNY/gram with source URL.
schema.name: gold_price_lookup

schema.description: Search file contents under the project root via Python regex. Three output modes: files_with_matches (default), content, count.
schema.name: grep

context.description: Lines of context before/after each match (content mode only).

schema.description: Extract text from an image (screenshot / photo / scan). Supports Chinese and English. Returns the recognized text. If the OCR engine is unavailable the result has error='ocr_engine_missing' — tell the user honestly. The image must first be chosen via office_pick_file (filter_key='image').
schema.name: image_ocr

schema.description: List files + subdirectories of a path with name/type/size.
schema.name: list_directory

schema.description: Forget a previously-remembered fact. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to forget something. Prefer fact_id when known.
schema.name: memory_forget

fact_id.description: Exact fact ID to forget (preferred when known via an earlier memory_facts_list call)

query.description: Natural-language description of what to forget (requires admin to enable)

schema.description: Read a specific memory record by integer id.
schema.name: memory_read

memory_id.description: Exact fact ID (returned by memory_write or memory_search).

schema.description: Search the current owner's frozen conversation memory scope.
schema.name: memory_recall

schema.description: Search Simple Harness memory by free-text query. Returns up to top_k matching facts (LIKE-based; future EnhancedRetriever upgrade).
schema.name: memory_search

schema.description: Persist a fact / observation to Simple Harness long-term memory. Use when the user shares a preference, name, project detail, or any fact worth recalling later.
schema.name: memory_write

pinned.description: Pin this memory so Simple Harness never lets it decay/forget. Set true when the user explicitly says to ALWAYS remember or never forget (e.g. "记住/别忘了/永远记住 ..."). Pinned facts skip the daily decay sweep.

tier.description: l1=short-term/event, l2=mid-term/project, l3=long-term/preference. Default auto = preference.

schema.description: Atomically move one file after verifying its SHA-256. Refuses overwrite by default.
schema.name: move_file

schema.description: Open a native Windows file/folder picker so the USER can choose a file or directory. You MUST call this before reading or editing any existing file on disk — office tools refuse paths the user has not picked. Returns the chosen absolute path (now authorized for this session). kind='file' to open an existing file, kind='dir' to pick a folder, kind='save' to choose a save destination.
schema.name: office_pick_file

kind.description: file=open existing, save=choose save path, dir=pick folder.

title.description: Dialog title shown to the user (optional).

schema.description: Convert a Word / PowerPoint / Excel / ODF document to PDF using the bundled LibreOffice engine. Returns the .pdf path. If the PDF engine is unavailable the result has error='soffice_missing' — tell the user honestly, never claim success. The input file must have been picked via office_pick_file or just created by another office tool.
schema.name: pdf_export

input_path.description: Absolute path of the source document.

output_path.description: Absolute .pdf path; omit to auto-create in temp.

schema.description:
【注意：若用户只给主题就要做 PPT（含「惊艳/AI配图」需求），请改用 ppt_pro —— 它会自动调研+大纲确认+优先生图/连不上回退模板。本工具仅用于：用户已给出完整 outline / 明确要跳过调研和确认 / 只要朴素快出 / 要一次做模板与AI各一份。】
Generate a professional .pptx presentation locally from an outline. Returns the file path on success; falls back to a Markdown outline when python-pptx is unavailable. 生成成功后【必须】把返回的 path 完整路径告诉用户(用户要知道文件存哪了)。Use this AFTER you've decided on a structured slide outline. Do not stuff long paragraphs into bullets — bullets are cues, not scripts.
两种视觉风格(二选一,别混用):
① AI 整页生图(最惊艳,适合'用AI配图/惊艳/视觉冲击/封面海报感'的需求): 每页 layout='image_full' + 写一段英文 image_prompt,Simple Harness 会用 AI 出图生成电影感全屏背景图铺满整页、标题压在底部暗带。这种模式【不要】传 template 参数。每张图约 1~2 分钟,4 页请耐心等。
② 模板填充(可编辑/正式商务): 传 template=模板名,用模板的设计页填文字。这种模式【不要】给页面写 image_prompt(模板自带配图,AI 图用不上会白生成)。
schema.name: ppt_create

author.description: Author name. Defaults to Simple Harness.

dry_run.description: WI-T1.6 outline 预览模式。True → 不写 .pptx，仅返回 outline markdown 作为 text artifact 供用户确认。建议 ≥ 5 张幻灯片的 deck 先 dry_run=true 让用户审查 outline，再 dry_run=false 实际生成。

outline.description:
List of slide dicts, OR a JSON string of such a list. Each slide: {layout, title, subtitle?, bullets?, left?, right?, left_title?, right_title?, image_path?, image_prompt?, caption?, quote?, cite?, notes?}. layout ∈ {title, section, bullet, two_column, image, image_full, quote, toc}.
image_full = AI 全幅生图页(惊艳+丰富,首选): 配 image_prompt(英文,电影感全屏画面,深色调、主体偏右、no text no watermark)。★封面页只给 title+caption → 全幅图+底部暗带;★内容页给 title+bullets(3-4 条,每条≤24字精炼) → 全幅图+左侧深色面板放标题和要点(我方自控排版,不挤)。这样既惊艳又有内容,做整份 AI 视觉 PPT 时每页都用 image_full(封面无 bullets,内容页带 bullets)。
image_prompt = 该页要 AI 生成的图。image_full 页必配。传了 template 时也可写 image_prompt: 会把 AI 图换进模板的图片位(模板专业排版 + 定制 AI 视觉)。

output_path.description: Absolute output path. Defaults to a temp file.

template.description:
可编辑模板填充。用户要『正式/专业/精美/可编辑』PPT 时优先用模板:从下列【大类】里【按名字精确】选一个传入(只传大类名,别自己编名字),桌宠会按预览图为你的主题挑该类里最合适的一套设计。也可直传 .pptx 绝对路径。按主题选最贴的风格：
「通用商务」通用商务风、专业稳妥。外部大库不可用时的兜底,适合各类职场汇报/工作总结/计划。(约 3 套)。

theme.description: Visual theme. minimal=clean business; dark=tech demos; playful=marketing.

schema.description: List structured process identities. This does not stop processes.
schema.name: process_list

schema.description: Start a long-lived GUI app, game, server, or script and return immediately with a same-Run process lease. Pass the executable and each argument separately; shell command strings are rejected. To launch a PowerShell script, use executable='powershell.exe' and argv=['-NoProfile','-File','C:/.../x.ps1']. For desktop control after launch, call window_list and pass its pid + creation_time + hwnd to window_focus, window_capture, or window_key.
schema.name: process_start

schema.description: Stop a same-run lease or an exact PID identity. Process-name kills are forbidden.
schema.name: process_stop

schema.description: Wait for a same-run process lease without killing it on timeout.
schema.name: process_wait

schema.description: Ask the user to confirm the local directory for a multi-file project. Call this before reading/writing project files or spawning a child workflow when (a) the user asks to create a new game, app, website, repository, or similar project, or (b) the user refers to an existing project such as 'this project/这个项目' but this task has no explicit confirmed project directory. Use directory_mode=use_existing for (b). A directory typed in chat is only a suggestion and must still be confirmed through the native folder card. A previously selected Session workspace does not remove this requirement when the user asks for a new project. The host shows a native folder picker, binds the selected project directory to this task and Session, and resumes this exact tool call. Do not invent an absolute path and do not create project files first.
schema.name: project_directory_select

directory_mode.description: Use create_new for a new empty folder. Use use_existing when the user explicitly asks to continue/check/fix a project already present at that path, including deictic 'this project' requests.

folder_name.description: Safe suggested child folder name only, without slashes or an absolute parent path.

project_kind.description: Short project type such as Godot game or web app.

schema.description: Send one completed message to all connected project groups. This is an irreversible external action and always requires a separate one-shot action confirmation.
schema.name: project_group_send

schema.description: Read a text file. Returns content, line count, truncation flag. Pass offset+limit for large files.
schema.name: read_file

schema.description: Register existing files inside the selected project as formal Harness artifacts. This is read-only: it never creates, copies, moves, or modifies files. Use this when the user asks to deliver files that already exist; do not fabricate an artifact-card JSON or receipt file.
schema.name: register_artifacts

paths.description: Existing file paths, absolute or relative to the selected project directory.

schema.description: Run an autonomous natural-language browser task for END-TO-END testing (e.g. 'open http://localhost:5173, click the Send button, verify a reply bubble appears'). LLM-driven via browser-use + Chromium. Long-running: returns instantly with a job_id; poll with action='result'. Constrained to localhost/127.0.0.1 unless allow_external=true. Disabled unless [code_e2e].browser_use_enabled=true in config.toml.
schema.name: run_browser_task

action.description: 'start' (default) dispatches a new run; 'result'/'poll' fetch the outcome of an earlier job_id.

allow_external.description: Permit a non-local start_url + internet navigation. Default false (test agents stay on localhost).

start_url.description: Optional URL to open first. Must be localhost/127.0.0.1 unless allow_external=true.

task.description: Natural-language E2E instruction. Required for action='start'.

schema.description: Execute a shell command. On Windows the runtime auto-picks the best shell available: Git Bash (preferred) → bundled busybox sh → PowerShell → cmd. Use Linux-style commands (ls / grep / sed / awk / find / cat / curl all work via Git Bash or busybox); forward-slash paths are accepted. Captures stdout/stderr/exit_code. Default timeout 30s. For a long-lived GUI app or server, prefer process_start (or app_launch) so this call can return immediately; a trailing POSIX '&' is detached from run_shell's stdio as a compatibility fallback. Asks user permission first.
schema.name: run_shell

command.description: Shell command, maximum 2000 characters. Never embed whole file bodies or heredocs here; use write_file with mode=append in chunks.

schema.description: Use Scrapling to fetch a modern/dynamic web page and return raw HTML/text. Prefer this when normal web_fetch returns an app shell, 403, or empty content. For current gold price / XAU/USD, call gold_price_lookup first.
schema.name: scrapling_fetch

schema.description: Take a screenshot of the primary screen for visual inspection of a desktop app under test. Saves a PNG into the Simple Harness workspace and ALSO returns it base64-encoded so you (a vision-capable model) can look at it directly. Use this before every click to confirm UI state.
schema.name: screen_capture

name.description: Optional workspace filename (relative, .png). Default: an auto timestamped name under screenshots/.

schema.description: Click the mouse at primary-screen pixel (x, y). Coordinates are clamped into screen bounds (out-of-range is corrected, not rejected). Take a screen_capture first to know where to click.
schema.name: screen_click

schema.description: Press a keyboard key or hotkey combo. Use '+' to chord (e.g. 'ctrl+s', 'alt+f4', 'enter', 'tab'). Single keys also work ('esc', 'f5').
schema.name: screen_key

schema.description: Move the mouse cursor to primary-screen pixel (x, y) WITHOUT clicking. Coordinates are clamped into screen bounds. Useful to trigger hover states before a screen_capture.
schema.name: screen_move

schema.description: Vertical mouse-wheel scroll by N clicks (positive = up, negative = down). Magnitude is capped to prevent runaway scroll storms.
schema.name: screen_scroll

schema.description: Type a literal UTF-8 string into the currently focused control (as if typed on the keyboard). Click the target field first.
schema.name: screen_type

schema.description: Activate one Skill instruction from this Run's frozen catalog.
schema.name: skill_invoke

schema.description: Start one durable detached child for a batch of delegated tasks. Returns after the child is accepted; its terminal result is delivered durably.
schema.name: spawn_subagents

schema.description: Delegate a homogeneous task pool to 1-8 teammates. Use agent_parallel when child tasks need different kinds or prompts.
schema.name: spawn_team

kind.description: Capability and execution profile for the team.

schema.description: Mark a todo as done by id.
schema.name: todo_complete

schema.description: Replace the entire task list for the current task session. Provide all items every call (idempotent). Each item needs `content` (imperative form, e.g. 'Run tests'), `activeForm` (present-continuous, 'Running tests'), and `status` (pending|in_progress|completed). Exactly one item should be in_progress at a time.
schema.name: todo_write

schema.description: Activate a previously described capability for the next model iteration.
schema.name: tool_activate

schema.description: Return the exact schema for one deferred capability in this request. Copy capability_search.matches[].capability_id exactly. A bare tool name is accepted only when it has one unique match.
schema.name: tool_describe

capability_id.description: Prefer the complete capability_id returned by capability_search, for example builtin:desktop_create_file.

schema.description: Search only deferred capabilities authorized for this request.
schema.name: tool_search

query.description: Space-separated keywords. Matches against tool name + description, case-insensitive. Every token must appear.

toolset.description: Optional toolset filter: 'file', 'web', 'memory', 'todo', 'control'. Omit to search all toolsets.

schema.description: BFS same-origin crawl from a seed URL. Respects robots.txt + per-domain rate limit. Returns top-ranked pages by keyword frequency in title + body.
schema.name: web_crawl

keywords.description: Keywords to score pages by. Default [].

same_origin.description: Confine to seed's scheme+host. Default true.

schema.description: Extract structured article fields (title/author/date/text/language) from a URL or raw HTML using trafilatura. Falls back to selectolax for title+text if metadata extraction fails.
schema.name: web_extract_article

url_or_html.description: Either an absolute http(s) URL or raw HTML text.

schema.description: 抓取网页文本内容做调研。稳定接口名是 web_fetch，但底层优先使用 Scrapling 抓取，只有 Scrapling 不可用、失败或被拦截时才回退 httpx。Returns status + content + content_type. Follows up to 5 redirects. HTML truncated to 2MB. Respects robots.txt and per-domain rate limits from config. web_fetch 不是用来生成或获取图片；用户要生成、画图片请用 generate_image。
schema.name: web_fetch

schema.description: Fetch & parse an XML sitemap. Falls back to sitemap_index.xml if the primary sitemap 404s. Recursively unfurls sitemap indexes. Returns list of {url, lastmod}.
schema.name: web_read_sitemap

sitemap_url.description: Absolute sitemap URL, or a bare domain (e.g. 'docs.python.org') in which case /sitemap.xml is assumed.

schema.description: 联网搜索返回 top-N {title,url,snippet}。用于【快速查一下】事实/找网址/看有哪些来源,区域按查询语言自动切(中文走中文区)。要【深度调研出带引用的报告】请改用 deepresearch。不生成图片(画图用 generate_image)。
schema.name: web_search

hydrate_top.description: Fetch/extract正文 for top N results; default 0, hard cap 3.

schema.description: Capture only one exact window rectangle, not the full desktop. Returns a PNG path and base64 image for visual verification.
schema.name: window_capture

schema.description: Focus one exact visible window after PID-reuse validation.
schema.name: window_focus

schema.description: Focus one exact window, then press either one key/combo or a short ordered steps sequence. Prefer steps for a bounded movement burst, then call window_capture to inspect the result; do not submit parallel window_key calls. All pressed keys are released even after errors.
schema.name: window_key

items.description: A key step (non-empty keys, optional hold_ms and post-key pause_ms) or a pause-only step (positive pause_ms with keys omitted or empty).

schema.description: List visible top-level Windows windows with hwnd, PID, process creation time, title, and bounds. Use the returned exact identity for window_focus, window_capture, and window_key.
schema.name: window_list

schema.description: Create the already host-bound, task-local workspace. The path is chosen by the host and cannot be supplied by the model.
schema.name: workspace_prepare

schema.description: Recall files you've already read or written earlier in THIS task — search by path or content keyword. Use this before re-reading a file to check if you already know it. Returns path / last_action / content_summary for each match.
schema.name: workspace_recall

query.description: Path fragment or content keyword to search.

schema.description: Create a new file. Refuses to overwrite unless overwrite=true. Creates parent dirs. IMPORTANT: content is HARD-CAPPED at 3000 characters per call. For longer files, split into multiple calls: first call with content=<part 1>, then subsequent calls with mode='append' for each chunk. Calls over 3KB are rejected before execution to avoid streaming JSON-escape failures.
schema.name: write_file

content.description: File content. MAX 3000 chars per call — split longer files into append-mode chunks.

mode.description: Use append for every chunk after the first; append never replaces existing bytes.
